title: Replace Vedic Study Circles text with Hindi translation

requirements.summary: Replace the 'Vedic Study Circles' program card title with Hindi translation 'वैदिक स्टडी सर्कल'
acceptanceCriteria: The program card title displays 'वैदिक स्टडी सर्कल' instead of 'Vedic Study Circles'
The Hindi text renders correctly with proper Unicode support
The title maintains consistent styling with other program cards

file_operations.description: Update the 'Vedic Study Circles' ProgramCard component title prop from 'Vedic Study Circles' to 'वैदिक स्टडी सर्कल'. Locate the ProgramCard with the Vedic Study Circles content and change only the title prop value while preserving all other props and styling.

file_operations.description: Update the 'Vedic Study Circles' ProgramCard component description prop from 'Regular sessions for studying and discussing sacred texts including Vedas, Upanishads, and Bhagavad Gita. Learn from experienced scholars and deepen your spiritual understanding.' to 'वेद, उपनिषद और भगवद गीता जैसे पवित्र ग्रंथों की पढ़ाई और चर्चा के लिए रेगुलर सेशन। अनुभवी विद्वानों से सीखें और अपनी आध्यात्मिक समझ को गहरा करें।'. Locate the same ProgramCard for Vedic Study Circles and replace only the description prop value while maintaining consistent formatting with other program cards.
